candidate_source_binding: the fixed-shape Metal primitive, packed-W8 oracle, Objective-C++ bridge, shader, build wiring, live tests, count-6 gate driver, custody closure, and this predeclaration must be committed and pushed together before the first candidate performance sample

scope.stage: independent count-6 full-attention decode primitive gate only; a pass authorizes a separate real-checkpoint production-topology continuation and does not enable a runtime route
scope.target: Apple M4 Metal versus six independent current CpuBackend/Accelerate full-attention boundaries
scope.aggregate_semantics: six independent per-layer boundary fixtures; one full-attention residual is not fed directly to the next because the real model has intervening GDN/MLP layers outside this primitive gate
scope.production_submission_topology_preserved: six separate layer transactions, therefore six command buffers, six commits, and six waits per count-6 aggregate; the six layers are not artificially coalesced

hotspot_basis.projection_only_candidate_rejected_befor: existing screens show CPU five-projection and generic Metal projection latency too close to justify a projection-only route; the candidate covers the complete boundary

A.label: current_cpu_f32_accelerate_full_attention_count6
A.operations: six independent current CpuBackend/Accelerate full-attention residual boundaries

B.label: metal_g64_w8_full_attention_decode_v1_count6
B.weights: G64 W8 rows quantized once from the same deterministic F32 source rows

comparison_qualification.B_correctness_authority: independent packed-G64-W8 CPU oracle consuming the exact quantized rows uploaded to Metal

fixed_semantics.q_gate_checkpoint_layout: each query head stores [Q256, Gate256]; host packing deinterleaves per head before concatenating [Q2048, Gate2048, K512, V512]
fixed_semantics.input_and_qk_norm: mean-square RMSNorm with checkpoint weight plus 1.0
fixed_semantics.rope: non-interleaved rotate-half over dimensions 0..63, pairs (i,32+i), frequency theta^(-2i/64)
fixed_semantics.gqa_mapping: query head h maps to floor(h*2/8)=floor(h/4)
fixed_semantics.kv_layout: logical sequence-major fixtures are transposed into resident [layer_slot, kv_head, max_context, head_dim] buffers
fixed_semantics.cursor_authority: the primitive owns no sequence cursor; the model-wide cursor supplies start_pos and is advanced only after the whole model body succeeds
fixed_semantics.failure_transaction: a failed submitted call may dirty the uncommitted physical row, but it remains logically unreachable and the same-position retry overwrites it

correctness_gate.position_127_128_boundary_reason: the current CPU SDPA changes from scalar to grouped BLAS when kv_length reaches 128

fixed_performance_schedule.workload_reason: position 76 is the middle decode workload of the frozen raw13/free128 trajectory positions 13..139
fixed_performance_schedule.fixture_and_prefix_restore: outside timing before every aggregate call
fixed_performance_schedule.timing: host monotonic elapsed time around one synchronous count-6 aggregate only
fixed_performance_schedule.primary_statistic: even median of every raw aggregate-call latency in each block and pooled
fixed_performance_schedule.failure_policy: admission begins only after immutable preconditions pass and a canonical create-new durable attempt marker is reserved; any later crash leaves that marker and forbids a second execution, while caught correctness, sampled-call, receipt, or custody failures atomically replace it with the final rejection receipt

host_precondition_before_admission.process_cpu_percent_unit: one logical CPU core equals 100 percent

precommitted_admission.equality_behavior: pooled equality at 10.0 percent passes; a block improvement of exactly 0.0 percent is not positive
precommitted_admission.overall_pass: target/quiet/thermal preflight and postflight AND full B packed-oracle correctness and failure semantics AND exact live topology receipts and counts AND completed fixed schedule AND pooled threshold AND positive improvement in both blocks AND unchanged custody AND zero sampled failures
precommitted_admission.pass_authorizes: retain the primitive and begin a separately gated real-checkpoint teacher/free-128 production-topology continuation
precommitted_admission.pass_does_not_authorize: default enablement, an ApxInf end-to-end performance claim, or any llama.cpp, Ollama, or OmniInfer winner claim
precommitted_admission.failure_action: retain raw diagnostic evidence and do not integrate the candidate into production
